description: This file defines numeric types, conversion functions, and bit array classes used within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes templates for handling various number types, serialization/deserialization, and bit manipulation utilities.

classes.name: NumberType
classes.description: Template class for handling numeric types with serialization, deserialization, and network byte order conversions.

classes.name: Fractional
classes.description: Class representing fractional numbers with integer and remainder parts, supporting comparison and text representation.

classes.name: BitArrayBaseType
classes.description: Base template class for bit array manipulation, supporting set, clear, check, and find operations.

classes.name: BitArrayType
classes.description: Fixed-size bit array class derived from BitArrayBaseType.

classes.name: BitArrayFlexType
classes.description: Flexible-size bit array class derived from BitArrayBaseType.

methods.name: NumberType::Convert
methods.description: Converts string representations to numeric types, supporting different bases and signed/unsigned distinctions.

methods.name: Fractional::operator>=
methods.description: Greater than or equal comparison for Fractional numbers.

methods.name: Fractional::operator<=
methods.description: Less than or equal comparison for Fractional numbers.

methods.name: Fractional::operator>
methods.description: Greater than comparison for Fractional numbers.

methods.name: Fractional::operator<
methods.description: Less than comparison for Fractional numbers.

methods.name: Fractional::Text
methods.description: Returns string representation of the fractional number with specified decimal places.

methods.name: BitArrayBaseType::Set
methods.description: Sets the bit at the specified index.

methods.name: BitArrayBaseType::Clr
methods.description: Clears the bit at the specified index.

methods.name: BitArrayBaseType::IsSet
methods.description: Checks if the bit at the specified index is set.

methods.name: BitArrayBaseType::Empty
methods.description: Checks if all bits are cleared.

methods.name: BitArrayBaseType::Full
methods.description: Checks if all bits are set.

methods.name: BitArrayBaseType::Reset
methods.description: Resets the bit array to a specified initial value.

methods.name: BitArrayBaseType::Find
methods.description: Finds the first unset bit index.
